rules: No writes are allowed in v1.7.0.
No UI code may call Postgres, MySQL, D1, Workers, or database-specific code directly.
The browser app remains on the JSON adapter until the API adapter is intentionally enabled.
DATABASE_URL must be provided through Coolify environment variables, not committed files.
Future Coolify API responses must preserve this wrapper shape unless intentionally versioned.
